title: Introduction to GradBoostR
text: GradBoostR provides consistent interface random forest regression, gradient boosting regression, neural network regression, decision stumps, fast binary random forest classification implemented Rcpp RcppArmadillo. principal interface consists gradboostr_fit() gradboostr_predict(). Lower-level functions include fit_stump(), rf_class_fit_fast(), rf_class_predict_fast(), rf_class_predict_prob_fast(). vignette covers regression, cross-validation, learning-rate analysis, grid search, final model selection, decision stumps, linear nonlinear classification, confusion matrices, ROC curves, AUC, probability decision boundaries.

title: Introduction to GradBoostR
code: set.seed(864)  n_reg <- 120 X_reg <- cbind(   X1 = rnorm(n_reg),   X2 = rnorm(n_reg),   X3 = rnorm(n_reg) )  y_reg <- (   2.0 * X_reg[, "X1"] -   0.5 * X_reg[, "X2"] +   rnorm(n_reg, sd = 0.7) )  regression_data <- data.frame(   X1 = X_reg[, "X1"],   X2 = X_reg[, "X2"],   X3 = X_reg[, "X3"],   Response = y_reg ) head(regression_data, 8) #>           X1          X2          X3    Response #> 1  0.8259430 -1.21770927  0.79702852  2.72873606 #> 2  1.6837055 -0.40938819  0.96225350  4.21391230 #> 3 -2.9104891  0.09768491  0.17461701 -5.31318501 #> 4  1.8750856  0.14468638  0.02812713  3.53754995 #> 5  0.6510606  1.66285955 -1.69835956  0.01615669 #> 6 -0.7975370  0.01234072  0.45650717 -1.21428786 #> 7  1.1283158  0.69479572 -0.73021125  2.07743833 #> 8  0.7023991 -1.05993568 -0.29250443  0.59055968 ggplot(regression_data, aes(X1, Response)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.7, colour = "steelblue") +   geom_smooth(     method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,     colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   labs(     title = "Synthetic Regression Data",     subtitle = "The response contains a strong contribution from X1",     x = "X1", y = "Response"   ) rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {   sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2)) }  scale_train_validation <- function(training_data, validation_data) {   training_center <- colMeans(training_data)   training_scale <- apply(training_data, 2, sd)   training_scale[!is.finite(training_scale) | training_scale == 0] <- 1    scaled_training <- sweep(training_data, 2, training_center, FUN = "-")   scaled_training <- sweep(scaled_training, 2, training_scale, FUN = "/")    scaled_validation <- sweep(validation_data, 2, training_center, FUN = "-")   scaled_validation <- sweep(scaled_validation, 2, training_scale, FUN = "/")    list(train = scaled_training, validation = scaled_validation) }

code: set.seed(452)  n_folds <- 3 fold_id <- sample(   rep(seq_len(n_folds), length.out = nrow(X_reg)) )  stopifnot(   length(fold_id) == nrow(X_reg),   length(y_reg) == nrow(X_reg) ) table(fold_id) #> fold_id #>  1  2  3  #> 40 40 40

title: Introduction to GradBoostR
text: 3 fold gradient boosting learning-rate results
code: gbm_learning_rate_values <- c(0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20)  gbm_learning_rate_results <- do.call(   rbind,   lapply(seq_along(gbm_learning_rate_values), function(rate_index) {     current_rate <- gbm_learning_rate_values[rate_index]     fold_rmse <- numeric(n_folds)      for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {       training_rows <- fold_id != fold       validation_rows <- fold_id == fold       set.seed(4000 + rate_index * 100 + fold)        model <- gradboostr_fit(         X_reg[training_rows, , drop = FALSE],         y_reg[training_rows],         method = "gbm",         learning_rate = current_rate,         n_trees = 50       )        prediction <- as.vector(         gradboostr_predict(           model,           X_reg[validation_rows, , drop = FALSE]         )       )        fold_rmse[fold] <- rmse(y_reg[validation_rows], prediction)     }      data.frame(       Model = "Gradient boosting",       LearningRate = current_rate,       MeanRMSE = mean(fold_rmse),       SDRMSE = sd(fold_rmse)     )   }) )  gbm_learning_rate_results <- gbm_learning_rate_results[   order(gbm_learning_rate_results$MeanRMSE), ] row.names(gbm_learning_rate_results) <- NULL  knitr::kable(   gbm_learning_rate_results,   digits = 4,   caption = paste(n_folds, "fold gradient boosting learning-rate results") ) ggplot(gbm_learning_rate_results, aes(LearningRate, MeanRMSE)) +   geom_errorbar(     aes(       ymin = pmax(MeanRMSE - SDRMSE, 0),       ymax = MeanRMSE + SDRMSE     ),     width = 0.003,     colour = "grey40"   ) +   geom_line(colour = "darkorange", linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(colour = "darkorange", size = 3) +   scale_x_log10(breaks = sort(gbm_learning_rate_values)) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   labs(     title = "Gradient Boosting Learning-Rate Analysis",     subtitle = paste("Mean validation RMSE across", n_folds, "folds"),     x = "Learning rate (log scale)",     y = "Cross-validated RMSE"   )

SDRMSE, 0),       ymax = MeanRMSE + SDRMSE     ),     width = 0.002,     colour = "grey40"   ) +   geom_line(colour = "dodgerblue3", linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(colour = "dodgerblue3", size = 3) +   scale_x_log10(breaks = sort(nn_learning_rate_values)) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   labs(     title = "Neural Network Learning-Rate Analysis",     subtitle = paste("Mean validation RMSE across", n_folds, "folds"),     x = "Learning rate (log scale)",     y = "Cross-validated RMSE"   )

title: Introduction to GradBoostR
text: Gradient boosting grid-search results
code: gbm_parameter_grid <- expand.grid(   LearningRate = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10),   Trees = c(25, 50),   KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  gbm_cv_results <- do.call(   rbind,   lapply(seq_len(nrow(gbm_parameter_grid)), function(parameter_index) {     parameters <- gbm_parameter_grid[parameter_index, , drop = FALSE]     fold_rmse <- numeric(n_folds)      for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {       training_rows <- fold_id != fold       validation_rows <- fold_id == fold       set.seed(1000 + parameter_index * 100 + fold)        model <- gradboostr_fit(         X_reg[training_rows, , drop = FALSE],         y_reg[training_rows],         method = "gbm",         learning_rate = parameters$LearningRate,         n_trees = parameters$Trees       )        prediction <- as.vector(         gradboostr_predict(           model,           X_reg[validation_rows, , drop = FALSE]         )       )       fold_rmse[fold] <- rmse(y_reg[validation_rows], prediction)     }      data.frame(       LearningRate = parameters$LearningRate,       Trees = parameters$Trees,       MeanRMSE = mean(fold_rmse),       SDRMSE = sd(fold_rmse)     )   }) )  gbm_cv_results <- gbm_cv_results[order(gbm_cv_results$MeanRMSE), ] row.names(gbm_cv_results) <- NULL best_gbm_parameters <- gbm_cv_results[1, , drop = FALSE]  knitr::kable(   gbm_cv_results,   digits = 4,   caption = "Gradient boosting grid-search results" ) gbm_grid_plot <- gbm_cv_results gbm_grid_plot$Trees <- factor(gbm_grid_plot$Trees)  ggplot(   gbm_grid_plot,   aes(LearningRate, MeanRMSE, colour = Trees, group = Trees) ) +   geom_errorbar(     aes(       ymin = pmax(MeanRMSE - SDRMSE, 0),       ymax = MeanRMSE + SDRMSE     ),     width = 0.004   ) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   labs(     title = "Gradient Boosting Grid Search",     x = "Learning rate",     y = "Cross-validated RMSE",     colour = "Trees"   )

code: set.seed(623)  n_stump <- 200 X_stump <- cbind(   X1 = rnorm(n_stump),   X2 = rnorm(n_stump),   X3 = rnorm(n_stump) )  y_stump <- ifelse(   X_stump[, "X1"] > 0,   3 + X_stump[, "X2"],   -3 + X_stump[, "X2"] ) + rnorm(n_stump, sd = 0.4)  stump_model <- fit_stump(X_stump, y_stump)  predict_stump <- function(X, model) {   feature <- model$feature + 1L   ifelse(     X[, feature] <= model$threshold,     model$left_val,     model$right_val   ) }  stump_prediction <- predict_stump(X_stump, stump_model) rmse(y_stump, stump_prediction) #> [1] 3.495421

title: Introduction to GradBoostR
code: classification_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {   actual <- as.integer(actual)   predicted <- as.integer(predicted)    tp <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 1)   tn <- sum(actual == 0 & predicted == 0)   fp <- sum(actual == 0 & predicted == 1)   fn <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 0)    accuracy <- (tp + tn) / length(actual)   precision <- tp / max(1, tp + fp)   recall <- tp / max(1, tp + fn)   specificity <- tn / max(1, tn + fp)   f1 <- if (precision + recall == 0) {     0   } else {     2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)   }    data.frame(     Accuracy = accuracy,     Precision = precision,     Recall = recall,     Specificity = specificity,     F1 = f1   ) }  roc_curve_data <- function(actual, probability) {   thresholds <- sort(     unique(c(Inf, probability, -Inf)),     decreasing = TRUE   )    roc_points <- lapply(thresholds, function(threshold) {     predicted <- as.integer(probability >= threshold)     tp <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 1)     tn <- sum(actual == 0 & predicted == 0)     fp <- sum(actual == 0 & predicted == 1)     fn <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 0)      data.frame(       Threshold = threshold,       TPR = tp / max(1, tp + fn),       FPR = fp / max(1, fp + tn)     )   })    result <- do.call(rbind, roc_points)   result[order(result$FPR, result$TPR), ] }  auc_from_roc <- function(roc_data) {   roc_data <- roc_data[order(roc_data$FPR, roc_data$TPR), ]   sum(     diff(roc_data$FPR) *       (head(roc_data$TPR, -1) + tail(roc_data$TPR, -1)) / 2   ) }  confusion_plot_data <- function(actual, predicted) {   as.data.frame(     table(       Observed = factor(actual, levels = c(0, 1)),       Predicted = factor(predicted, levels = c(0, 1))     )   ) }

code: classification_surface_forest <- rf_class_fit_fast(   X_class,   y_class,   n_trees = 100,   max_depth = 6 )  classification_grid <- expand.grid(   X1 = seq(     min(classification_data$X1),     max(classification_data$X1),     length.out = 150   ),   X2 = seq(     min(classification_data$X2),     max(classification_data$X2),     length.out = 150   ) )  classification_grid$Probability <- as.vector(   GradBoostR::rf_class_predict_prob_fast(     as.matrix(classification_grid[, c("X1", "X2")]),     classification_surface_forest   ) )  stopifnot(   length(classification_grid$Probability) == nrow(classification_grid) ) ggplot() +   geom_raster(     data = classification_grid,     aes(X1, X2, fill = Probability),     interpolate = FALSE   ) +   geom_contour(     data = classification_grid,     aes(X1, X2, z = Probability),     breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9),     colour = "white",     linewidth = 0.45   ) +   geom_contour(     data = classification_grid,     aes(X1, X2, z = Probability),     breaks = 0.5,     colour = "black",     linewidth = 0.9   ) +   geom_point(     data = classification_data,     aes(X1, X2, colour = Class),     alpha = 0.65,     size = 1.3   ) +   scale_fill_viridis_c(     limits = c(0, 1),     name = "P(Class = 1)"   ) +   scale_colour_manual(     values = c("Inside" = "#2166AC", "Outside" = "#B2182B")   ) +   coord_equal() +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   labs(     title = "GradBoostR Classification Probability Surface",     subtitle = "The black contour is the P(Class = 1) = 0.5 decision boundary",     x = "X1", y = "X2", colour = "Observed class"   )
